label: The exact #456 response compatibility theorem is reused, by Direct-proof
meaning: The exact #456 response compatibility theorem is reused. Its activated-response causal adapter has distinct existing endpoints, a necessary bearer and a directed marker at both worlds. With the same existence extension, zero responses refute necessity-of-existence implying necessity-of-capacity. Positive responses refute necessity-of-capacity implying necessary exercise, and exercise at true implying necessary exercise. The existing alternating-effects interpretation has necessary source and exercise but no fixed necessary effect, a contingent recipient, and a true world proposition that is not necessary. For Type-valued carriers, a local manifestation rule together with boxed capacity entails necessary exercise. These are stipulated formal controls, not source attribution, metaphysical possibility or a complete intrinsic-power theory.
